units.source_text: 在高山寺，千重子喜欢从石水院那宽阔的廊道上眺望对面的山姿，也喜欢观赏祖师明惠上人树上坐禅的肖像画。

en.t: At Kozanji, Chieko liked gazing at the shape of the mountains opposite from the broad veranda of Sekisui-in, and she also liked looking at the portrait of the founder, Saint Myoe, seated in meditation in a tree.

units.source_text: 在壁龛旁边摊放着一幅《鸟兽戏图》的复制品。

en.t: Beside the alcove, a reproduction of the Choju-giga scroll was spread out.

units.source_text: 她们两人受到了招待，在这条廊道上喝茶。

en.t: The two of them were received as guests and drank tea on that veranda.
